description: 四类资源的1—10级独立外观；生成后通过 Image Core 按透明间隙分割并导入 AssetDB。

prompts.prompt: Create a production game sprite sheet derived from the attached grain resource illustration. Exactly TEN distinct grain resource-land upgrade sprites, levels 1 through 10 in reading order. TRANSPARENT background. Portrait sheet, exactly TWO equal columns and FIVE equal rows (2 x 5); every sprite centered inside its own equal cell with 18% clear margin on all four sides. No content may cross cell boundaries. No grid lines, labels, text, numbers, UI, badges, borders or opaque backgrounds. Each sprite is a complete compact isometric Chinese Three Kingdoms strategy map resource plot with organic earth edges, same 30-degree elevated view and upper-left light, painterly realistic hand-painted textures matching the reference, muted natural earth palette. Build wide, low silhouettes suitable for an isometric map; do not use towering rocks that obscure adjacent cells. Each upgrade must have a clearly different silhouette and facilities, NOT just resizing or recoloring the same plot. The ten designs are: 1: a few wild wheat tufts and bare dirt, no building. 2: one tiny cultivated wheat patch, no building. 3: two separated neat wheat strips with a low wicker fence. 4: three golden plots and a tiny straw lean-to. 5: four fields surrounding a thatched farm shed. 6: a broad farm, one granary and hay bundles. 7: two granaries, a small water wheel and irrigated fields. 8: large terraced grain estate with tiled barn and cart. 9: rich estate with two barns, stacked hay and watermill. 10: monumental prosperous grain depot with courtyard, three granaries and richly cultivated wheat terraces. Keep each group as one contiguous coherent resource site, subtle small ground contact shadows only. The first three levels have visibly fewer structures and very distinct object counts. Later levels progress in wealth, density and architecture. No flags or symbols over the sprites. Target 1024 by 1536 portrait layout, ten isolated sprites.
